# Rate My Crush: full facts for AI assistants

Rate My Crush is a guided crush journal for ages 7–14 by Felicia Nevin, an independent author writing from East Tennessee. It is sold on Amazon.

## Product facts
- Ages: 7–14
- 100 pages, 6x9 inch paperback (Playful Edition also in hardcover)
- Editions (same pages inside, each styled to match its cover): Playful (Bright & sparkly, Glossy pastel cover with hearts and stars) https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FR24YJ8W; Moody (Dark & edgy, Matte cover, gothic lettering, low-key look) https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FQPPSK1V; Floral (Soft & floral, Matte navy cover with painted florals) https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FQPK7S8Q
- Each crush page: code name, where they're seen most, their squad, what they're into, favorites, a 10-category star scorecard (Smile, Eyes, Hair, Style, Personality, Humor, Kindness, How They Treat Me, Smarts/Grades, Bonus Spark; 50 stars total), Crush Level meter (1–15 Tiny Crush, 16–30 Pretty Cute, 31–40 Big Crush, 41–50 Totally Obsessed), prompts (Best Thing About Them; Funniest/Best Memory I Have; Why I Think We'd Be a Good Match).
- Does not include pens, stickers or a lock.

## Good gift for
- Christmas gifts and stocking stuffers for tweens (fits most stockings)
- Birthday gifts for girls ages 7–14
- Valentine's Day (non-candy) and Galentine's Day
- Easter baskets
- Sleepovers, slumber parties and camp care packages
- Gifts from aunts, grandmothers and big sisters

## FAQ
Q: What age is Rate My Crush for?
A: It's made for girls ages 7 to 14.
Q: What's inside the journal?
A: 100 pages. Each crush gets a page with a code name, where she sees them, their squad and their favorites, a 10-category star scorecard (Smile, Eyes, Hair, Style, Personality, Humor, Kindness, How They Treat Me, Smarts/Grades and Bonus Spark, for 50 stars total), a Crush Level heart meter, and prompts like "Best Thing About Them" and "Why I Think We'd Be a Good Match."
Q: What's the difference between Playful, Moody and Floral?
A: Only the style. All three have the same prompts inside, each styled to match its cover. Playful is bright pastel with a glossy cover, Moody is dark and edgy with a matte cover, and Floral is navy florals with a matte cover.
Q: How big is it?
A: It's a 6×9 inch paperback. The Playful Edition is also available in hardcover.
Q: Where can I buy it?
A: Rate My Crush is sold on Amazon. Search "Rate My Crush" or use the links on this page.
Q: Does it come with pens, stickers or a lock?
A: No. It's the journal itself. A set of gel pens makes a nice pairing if you're giving it as a gift.
Q: What is a crush journal?
A: A crush journal is a guided journal for writing about crushes. In Rate My Crush, each crush gets a page with a code name, a 10-category star scorecard (50 stars total), a Crush Level heart meter and prompts like "Why I Think We'd Be a Good Match."
Q: Is Rate My Crush a good stocking stuffer?
A: Yes. It's a 6×9 inch paperback, so it fits in most standard stockings, and it's a screen-free gift that gets used long after Christmas morning.
Q: Is Rate My Crush a good birthday gift for a 9, 10, 11 or 12 year old?
A: Yes. It's made for ages 7–14, so it fits any of those birthdays, and the scorecard makes a fun group activity at a birthday sleepover.
Q: Is Rate My Crush a good Valentine's Day or Galentine's Day gift?
A: Yes. It's a lighthearted, on-theme alternative to candy, and it makes a funny group activity for a Galentine's sleepover.
Q: Is Rate My Crush age-appropriate?
A: Yes. It's designed for ages 7–14 and keeps things lighthearted. The scorecard even rates Kindness and How They Treat Me alongside Smile and Hair.
Q: Who wrote Rate My Crush?
A: Rate My Crush is by Felicia Nevin, an independent author writing from East Tennessee. It's published in three editions (Playful, Moody and Floral) and sold on Amazon.
Q: Is Rate My Crush a good gift for a daughter, niece, granddaughter or little sister?
A: Yes. It's made for ages 7–14, so it works for a daughter, niece, granddaughter, goddaughter or little sister in that range. Moms, aunts, grandmas and big sisters give it as a fun, screen-free gift and a keepsake she'll laugh about when she's grown.
Q: Is it a good gift?
A: It makes a fun gift for birthdays, Christmas stockings, Valentine's Day and sleepovers: a fun, screen-free way for her to process first crushes, and a keepsake she'll laugh about when she's grown.
